newsitem.title: USA: Level Best Golf won't consider offering.
newsitem.headline: Level Best Golf won't consider offering.

text.p: Level Best Golf Inc said on Tuesday it it is not in any talks about a "S Registration" offering of its securities.

"Level Best Golf has not, nor will it ever, consider any financing strategy or compensation package which includes an 'S Registration' of common shares or any other negatively dilutive tactic," company president Fred Solomon said in a statement.
The company issued the statement in response to rumors about a possible "S Registration" offering.

"We have received several unsolicited proposals (for financing) and, after due diligence, we have concluded that these proposals were not in the best interest of the company or its shareholders," Solomon said.
